![kody code-review](https://img.shields.io/badge/kody-code--review-312B4B?labelColor=C9BBF2) ![Bug](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bug-B71C1C) ![high](https://img.shields.io/badge/severity_level-high-6B6B92)


**Longest-prefix matching misassigns directory groups to other repositories**

Config and rule sync can apply files to the wrong repository when a directory group path matches another repository's `full_name`. Disambiguate repository folders from directory-group folders instead of treating every `full_name` entry as a folder name.



<details>
<summary>Prompt for LLM</summary>

````text
File libs/centralized-config/infrastructure/adapters/services/centralized-config.service.ts, lines 283-285:

Longest-prefix matching misassigns directory groups to other repositories

A directory group can be assigned to another repository when its path also matches that repository's `full_name`: for example, repository `acme` with group `my-repo` is interpreted as repository `acme/my-repo` instead of the `acme` repository's directory group. Both config and rule sync then apply the files to the wrong repository, so disambiguate repository folders from directory-group folders rather than treating every `full_name` map entry as a folder name.
````

</details>


<sub>Talk to Kody by mentioning @kody</sub>


<sub>Was this suggestion helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to help Kody learn from this interaction.</sub>

<!-- kody-codereview -->​
